as_told.title: Non-terrestrial officers list read as an off-Earth fleet / space supply chain

plain: Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who worked from London, says that around 2000 to 2002 he got into a US Navy computer system and found a spreadsheet titled "non-terrestrial officers". He says it also listed transfers of unusual chemicals such as molybdenum, along with transfers between ships and between whole fleets. McKinnon says he took it to mean people based off Earth, like a secret space force, rather than aliens, which would point to a hidden fleet and supply chain in space.
